name: boson-explore
description: Skills for the boson EDA toolchain: explore a block's area/power/timing design space (tables or an animated sweep video), close timing without touching the RTL, change the RTL with boson as the judge, and diagnose a bad boson result — decisions on failing paths, datapath architecture, a deep construct, or the gap to a reference netlist — with an anonymized, leak-checked bundle for partcl.
